decisions.reason: After two years without website presence and given its weak fit with the firm's industrial waste-to-value strategy, management would discontinue the consumer superfood mix and redeploy resources.
Despite no recent website mention, the modular waste-to-energy extensions still fit the firm's engineering-led decentralized systems business and can remain available as a project-based line.
The waste-oil-to-energy plant remains highly aligned with the firm's flagship waste-to-value direction, so management would keep it even if marketing emphasis has shifted.
